title: HB1439 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-01-31; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2673015)
provenance.note: Draft as filed (2023-01-31); effective July 1, 2023. House/Senate twin document.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1316(s)): (1) It is an offense to knowingly give, sell, lend, deliver, or otherwise transfer a firearm to a person when the transferor knows or reasonably should know that the person receiving the firearm is prohibited from purchasing or possessing a firearm under state or federal law.
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1316(s)): (2) A violation of this subsection is a Class A misdemeanor.
